eyebrow: Column masks — hiding a column's value
code:
CREATE FUNCTION mask_vendor_id(vendor_id STRING)
RETURNS STRING
RETURN CASE
  WHEN is_member('data-engineers') THEN vendor_id
  ELSE 'REDACTED'
END;

ALTER TABLE nyc_taxi.silver.trips
ALTER COLUMN VendorID SET MASK mask_vendor_id;
caption: Applied automatically, per query -- the same SELECT *, different results per user.
Rows where the function returns false simply don't appear, for that user.
